newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Davis County SD, Utah.

text.p: NOTICE OF BOND SALE WITH RESPECT TO
Board of Education of Davis County School District

Sealed bids for the purchase of $40,000,000 General Obligation Bonds (Utah School Bond Guaranty Program), Series 1997 (the Bonds'') of the Board of Education of Davis County School District, Davis County, Utah (the
will be received up to 9:30 a.m., M.D.T., on
Sealed bids will be received at the offices of Zions Bank Public Finance, the Financial Advisor to the Board, at its address listed below.
The Bonds will be dated August 15, 1997, will fully registered bonds, in book-entry form, in denominations of $5,000 or integral multiples thereof, and will mature serially on June 1 as follows:

Copies of the Official Notice of Bond Sale, the Official Statement, and other related information with respect to the Bonds being offered subject to the approval as to the legality of Ballard Spahr Andrews &Ingersoll, Attorneys at Law, Salt Lake City, Utah, may be obtained from Zions Bank Public Finance, at 215 South State Street, Suite 700, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111-2336, (801) 524-2100, fax (801) 524- 2109.
